content:
ian: Postmortem follow-up: we agreed to consolidate runbook edits and close the open remediation actions. Dropping owners and short deliverables here so we can mark RW-INC-4932 done.

meera: I'll own the "when to page" box and the short TL;DR at the top of the playbook. ETA Tue EOD. Proposal: page on sustained p95 delta >12% for 7m OR error rate >0.5% for 4m.

jin: I'll own the triage commands + a tiny incident_collect script. Will add exact admin API calls for fallback routing and a verification checklist (what metrics to watch). PR by Wed.

claire: I'll update the runbook's escalation matrix and add PD service names + a 2-step exec notify path. Also will add a link to the recurring-pattern dashboard once luis finishes it. PR by Thu.

ian: Sounds good. Two additional asks: 1) add explicit steps to detect deploy-related cold-starts and cache flushes, 2) add a brief test procedure for the prewarm job.

meera: For deploy/cold-start detection I'll add a small checklist item: check deploy timestamp vs spike, inspect KV miss rate change in last 10m, check model_load_time_ms. Example quick command I'll include: 
```bash
# check recent deploys
cat /var/log/deploys.log | tail -n 50
# KV miss rate (last 10m)
curl -sS 'http://localhost:9090/metrics' | grep kv_miss_rate | tail -n 10
```

jin: Incident collector snippet I'll add to infra/tools: `incident_collect.sh` that runs a short set of commands and uploads to the incident bucket. Example content I'll include in the PR: 
```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p /tmp/incident/$1
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/metrics > /tmp/incident/$1/metrics.txt
redis-cli -u redis://redis-main:6379 HGETALL model_cache_summary > /tmp/incident/$1/cache.txt
journalctl -u redwood-runtime -n 500 --no-pager > /tmp/incident/$1/runtime.log
# upload (s3cli is our internal uploader)
s3cli upload /tmp/incident/$1 s3://incidents/$1
```
I'll annotate which fields we should inspect (queue_depth, kv_hit_rate, model_load_time_ms, gpu_util).

claire: Escalation snippet I'll add to the playbook: 
```text
1) Verify impact and window (p95 / error_rate).
2) If p95 > threshold -> PUT /admin/routing {"variant":"fallback"}
3) If kv_miss_rate spike -> trigger cache prewarm job and scale read-replicas.
4) If impact persists >30m -> exec notify.
5) Post-fix: run verification checks and close incident only after metrics stabilize for 20m.
```
I'll include PD service names and the SRE on-call rotation.

ops-bot: Created issue RW-INC-4932: "playbook/runbook - postmortem follow-ups & action tracking". Assigned to jin, meera, claire. Due 2026-04-08.

ian: Final owners/dates: meera (when-to-page + TL;DR - Tue 2026-03-31), jin (triage commands + incident_collect.sh - Wed 2026-04-01), claire (escalation matrix + PD mapping - Thu 2026-04-02). We'll review PRs together Fri 09:00.

meera: I'll also add a one-line 'how to verify remediation' section with a small checklist: check p50/p95 heatmap, kv_hit_rate, and absence of new model load failures for 20m.

jin: Tagging reviewers @claire and @meera on the PR when ready. If anyone wants different thresholds speak up now.

claire: :+1: looks good. I'll draft the PD snippet and link the runbook PR.

ian: Thanks all. Closing loop: once PRs merged, we'll mark RW-INC-4932 resolved and add a follow-up note on recurring-pattern dashboard link.
